ext.description: Spotify player for VS Code, made for coders: see what's playing, control it from the editor, and get music suggestions based on your taste, project and time of day.
cfg.language: Language of the extension. "auto" follows the VS Code display language.
cfg.clientId: Client ID of your app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard.
cfg.redirectPort: Local port used for sign-in. The Redirect URI in your Spotify app must be http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback.
cfg.suggestOnStartup: When VS Code opens, suggest some music if Spotify is paused.
cfg.style: How to show the music suggestion.
cfg.style.card: Card with the playlist cover in the middle of the editor. No sound.
cfg.style.modal: System dialog in the centre of the screen (with alert sound).
cfg.style.quickpick: List at the top, like the Command Palette (Esc to close).
cfg.style.notification: Subtle notification in the bottom-right corner.
cfg.pollInterval: How often (in seconds) to refresh the song in the status bar.
cfg.statusBarButtons: Extra buttons shown next to the song in the status bar.
cfg.history: Keep a local history of what you play (song, time, project and language). Stays on your computer and powers per-project and per-hour suggestions.
cfg.focusPause: Pause the music during focus breaks and resume afterwards.
cfg.hiddenMoods: Built-in moods to hide from the suggestions panel.
cfg.customMoods: Your own moods. Example: `[{ "label": "Metal", "emoji": "🤘", "query": "metal classics", "keywords": ["metal"] }]`. `query` is what is searched on Spotify; `keywords` find matching playlists of yours.
cfg.cm.label: Name shown on the chip.
cfg.cm.query: Spotify search used for this mood (defaults to the name).
cfg.cm.keywords: Words that identify your own playlists for this mood.
